description: Change a pricing function your workspace owns: its display name, description, status, tags, cost per unit or cost multiplier. Only the fields you send change. Built-in functions and other workspaces' functions cannot be changed. The endpoint, its credential and the schemas are not changed here. Needs a Last Price credential with function publish scope.

cost_multiplier.description: Multiplies the cost of each call, for a more expensive model tier. 1 is the default; stored to 4 decimal places.

cost_per_unit.description: What one call to the function costs, in USD.

description.description: What the function does. Null clears it.

display_name.description: The name people and agents see.

function_id.description: The pricing function UUID: id on a list_functions result.

status.description: active functions are routed to; draft, review, inactive and deprecated ones are not.

name: update_function
